faq.q: What is a titanium heat exchanger tube bundle?

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium heat exchanger tube bundle?
faq.a: Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle is designed for seamless tube bundle for shell & tube hx. The Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium heat exchanger tube bundle manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.
